simCle.description: Institutional system for the Foreign Languages Coordination at Instituto Tecnológico de Morelia. I participated as the leader of a four-person team and as a full-stack developer.
simCle.imageAlt: Preview of the Foreign Languages Coordination modular system
simCle.externalLabel: Visit the SIM de la CLE system in a new tab

detail.overview: SIM de la CLE is an institutional system developed for the Foreign Languages Coordination Office at Instituto Tecnológico de Morelia.
detail.challenge: The project required organizing different coordination processes within a maintainable platform designed to evolve through independent modules.
detail.solution: The team built a full-stack web application with Laravel 11, Livewire 3, Tailwind CSS 4 and PostgreSQL, prioritizing a clear interface and a scalable technical foundation.
detail.role: I participated as the leader of a four-person team and a full-stack developer, coordinating the work and contributing to the interface, application logic and data persistence.

highlights.leadership: Leadership and coordination of a four-person team.
highlights.fullStack: Full-stack development with Laravel, Livewire and PostgreSQL.
highlights.teamwork: Work organization and collaboration throughout the development cycle.

portfolio.description: Bilingual portfolio featuring public GitHub API integration, light and dark themes, and a responsive, accessible experience.
portfolio.imageAlt: Preview of Saúl Romero's personal portfolio
portfolio.externalLabel: Open the personal portfolio repository in a new tab

detail.overview: This portfolio presents my professional profile, experience, technologies and projects through a bilingual, accessible and responsive experience.
detail.challenge: The goal was to build a professional presence that clearly communicated my technical profile and could be maintained and expanded as my experience evolved.
detail.solution: I developed an application with Nuxt, Vue, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS, incorporating internationalization, light and dark modes and integration with the public GitHub API.
detail.role: I designed and developed the complete experience, from the component architecture and visual system to accessibility, bilingual content and data integration.

highlights.i18n: Content and navigation available in Spanish and English.
highlights.github: Integration with the public GitHub API, including loading, error and success states.
highlights.accessibility: Responsive design, keyboard navigation and support for reduced-motion preferences.
